svg.title: Why pursue this research, and where it may fail
svg.desc: The bridge is proven while no operation has beaten an incumbent. Possible advantages are encrypted evaluation with one representation and repair of a lost function. Open risks are cleartext throughput, simplification, and encrypted processing at native dimensions. Unified memory supports the host-GPU search loop.

g.text: The bridge is proven. No operation has beaten an incumbent yet.
Both halves are load-bearing. This is a research position, not a product claim.
One representation for cleartext and ciphertext.
ABC minimizes a function you have.
Search can recover one you have lost.
the shared digest already consumes 78% of the time
Native encrypted processing may stay out of reach
These are predictions, not hidden results.
host builds → GPU evaluates wide → host inspects → repeat
Host code, Metal shaders, and MPSGraph share one physical pool; large candidate tensors remain practical.
Capacity is usable, not free: N=1024, B=1000 peaked near 6 GB and fell from ~69 to 13.6 ticks/s.
